visual.general_description: Signed publisher consent-to-publish form (administrative); no clinical data.
visual.detailed_description: Phone photograph of a publisher consent-to-publish form on a single page with the publisher logo at top. Handwritten entries fill the patient name field, the journal and manuscript-number line, and a corresponding-author line; the 'myself' and 'my' options are circled. Printed paragraphs state that the information will be published without the (circled) 'my' name attached, but that full anonymity cannot be guaranteed; that the text, pictures and videos will be freely available to the general public; that the signer has been offered the chance to read the manuscript, and that signing does not remove privacy rights. Below, handwritten name, date and signature for the signer and for the author, then a printed instruction to keep the form in the case files and a publisher address footer.

visual.general_description: Institutional review board approval letter for publishing a case report (administrative); no clinical data.
visual.detailed_description: Phone photograph of an institutional review board approval letter on letterhead with quality-certification logos, institute name and address, telephone and fax block at top. It carries a reference number and date, an addressee block of two named doctors, a subject line naming the case report title, a short paragraph saying the board reviewed it at a meeting, a ten-row table of attending board members with affiliations and expertise, an approval sentence, three numbered notes about board registration and compliance with guidelines, and a handwritten signature above the convener's printed name. A camera watermark appears at the bottom left.
